entries.headline: Supplier network is SHIPPED and mature (invitations, public token portal /s/:token, auto-import, 6h reminder cron, risk scoring, engagement/audit logging, request-management UI). Business gaps are at the edges: scale of onboarding, data-quality wiring, Catena-X, and — critically — measurability.

goalCandidates.title: Bulk supplier onboarding (CSV/Excel upload → batch invite)
goalCandidates.businessImpact: HIGH — activation/growth. Only single-supplier add exists; the active Sales pipeline (GRAFE & masterbatch mfrs) each have dozens of upstream suppliers — one-at-a-time invite is the #1 onboarding friction. Directly lifts supplier activation volume.
goalCandidates.leverage: highest near-term supplier-growth lever that is NOT compliance/CO2
goalCandidates.note: new frontend import + batch supplier-invite path; reuse existing invite/token machinery.

goalCandidates.title: Enable Supabase read connector so TedOS can MEASURE supplier funnel (invite/activation/response/coverage)
goalCandidates.businessImpact: HIGH (meta-unblock) — without it every supplier metric here is hypothesis-only. With it, the watchdog can report real activation %, response time, primary-data coverage, risk distribution and prioritize correctly.
goalCandidates.blockedOn: you provide read-only Supabase credentials per connectors-setup.md
goalCandidates.note: read-only; does not touch product logic.

goalCandidates.title: Wire response_quality_score (completeness 40 / evidence 30 / recency 15 / source 15) — currently always NULL
goalCandidates.businessImpact: MED — data-quality visibility; surfaces weak supplier responses so customers know which to chase. Rubric + column already exist; only recompute logic missing.
goalCandidates.note: scoring/aggregation, not the CO2 calc itself.

goalCandidates.title: Org-level questionnaire template customization UI (global template only today)
goalCandidates.businessImpact: MED — enterprise adoption; larger customers need custom supplier questions. Clone exists; management UI incomplete.

goalCandidates.title: Catena-X / PCF data-space export readiness (spike → feasibility, not full build)
goalCandidates.businessImpact: HIGH strategic — the Sales segment (plastics/masterbatch suppliers to VW/BMW/Mercedes) is exactly who automotive OEMs push to deliver PCF via Catena-X. Today: messaging claims it, code has zero data-space integration (no IDS-DAPS, no eIDAS, no export format). Largest enterprise-adoption gap.
goalCandidates.note: HIGH risk + large effort; recommend a scoped feasibility spike first, not a build. Auto-flagged for approval.

goalCandidates.title: Map supplier emissions to correct Scope-3 category (auto-import defaults ALL to Cat.1 Purchased Goods)
goalCandidates.businessImpact: HIGH accuracy/compliance — every auto-imported supplier emission lands in Scope-3 Category 1 regardless of actual category, distorting the 15-category CSRD breakdown.
goalCandidates.note: touches CO2 categorization → HIGH risk; do NOT auto-implement. Auto-flagged for approval.

goalCandidates.title: Verify monthly_rollups.primary_data_pct compute job actually runs (CSRD Datenherkunft depends on it)
goalCandidates.businessImpact: HIGH compliance — if the rollup cron isn't running, the CSRD primary-vs-secondary data-lineage section is empty/stale. Static code can't confirm; needs live infra check.
goalCandidates.note: verification is read-only, but remediation touches compliance/CO2 rollups → HIGH. Auto-flagged for approval.

goalCandidates.title: Recurring supplier account (re-use prior responses across annual CSRD cycles)
goalCandidates.businessImpact: MED — retention/engagement; today every invite is a one-time form fill, so suppliers re-enter everything each year. Reduces repeat-cycle friction.
goalCandidates.note: introduces supplier auth + RLS → HIGH risk, large effort. Auto-flagged for approval.

absentByDesignOrLowPriority: eIDAS qualified e-signature — current typed attestation is CSRD-defensible for voluntary audits; only needed for regulatory enforcement (defer until a customer requires it).
Supplier incentive/gamification — no evidence of demand; low priority.
Inbound ERP webhook/embed API — pull-only flow is adequate for current SME segment.
entries.topRecommendation: Two unblocks dominate: (1) bulk supplier import — the only LOW/MEDIUM, non-compliance lever that directly raises activation volume for the real pipeline; (2) the read-only Supabase connector — until it exists, TedOS is blind to actual activation/response/coverage and every supplier metric is a guess. Catena-X is the biggest strategic prize but is a HIGH-risk, large build — start with a feasibility spike, not implementation.
